cmd:
systemctl list-timers --all 2>/dev/null | grep -E "maersk|cosco|expeditor|NEXT" | head -6
echo "=== останній запуск maersk-track-sync:"
systemctl status maersk-track-sync.service --no-pager 2>&1 | grep -E "Active|Main PID|Process" | head -3
echo "=== хвіст лога:"
tail -12 /root/direct-sync/maersk.log 2>&1
echo "=== журнал служби:"
journalctl -u maersk-track-sync -n 8 --no-pager 2>&1 | tail -8
